basic_details.short_information: Centre for Management Development (CMD) has announced 1 vacancy for the Project Engineer (Civil) post on a contract basis for a period of one year in Kerala. Candidates applying for the post must possess a Graduation in Civil Engineering from a recognised University. The pay scale for this position ranges from Rs. 35,000 to Rs. 45,000 and the selection process includes a Written Test, Proficiency Test, and Interview. One Year (extendable based on performance and requirement)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the Project Engineer (Civil) position must meet the required educational and experience criteria established by the Centre for Management Development.

rows.essential_qualification: Graduation in Civil Engineering from a recognised University with a minimum of 3 years of experience in building construction and/or road construction, including Design, Site Supervision, MBook Recording, Bill Preparation & Verification, QC, etc. Proficiency required in various project management tools, AutoCAD, and PRICE.
rows.desirable_qualification: Post Graduation in Structural Engineering / Geo Technical Engineering / Construction Management will be given preference.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The position is on a contract basis for a period of one year, which is extendable based on performance and requirement. The salary ranges from Rs. 35,000/- to Rs. 45,000/- and will be fixed based on the candidate's relevant experience and additional relevant qualifications acquired.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CMD Project Engineer (Civil)
content_sections.text: Prepare a detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV). Gather scanned copies of documents proving age, qualification, and experience. Note that copies of appointment letters, salary certificates, and pay slips will not be accepted in lieu of work experience certificates. Send the CV and scanned documents via email to [email protected] . Clearly mention the post applied for in the email subject and email matter.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process may include a Written Test, Proficiency Test, and Interview, for which call letters will be sent through the registered e-mail ID. Only post-qualification experience of the applicants will be considered.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Project Engineer position permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is on a contract basis for a period of one year, and it is extendable based on performance and requirement.

faq.question: Q2. What is the cut-off date for age and experience eligibility criteria?
faq.answer: The cut-off date for the purpose of eligibility on age criteria and post-qualification experience is 01/10/2026.

faq.question: Q3. What must be included in the email submission?
faq.answer: Applicants must send a detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV) along with scanned copies of documents proving age, qualification, and experience to [email protected], clearly mentioning the post applied for in the email subject and email matter.

faq.question: Q4. Will work experience certificates be verified using pay slips or salary certificates?
faq.answer: No. Copies of appointment letters, salary certificates, pay slips, etc., will not be accepted in lieu of work experience certificates.
